title: Invoicing & payments Delete lets the user delete payments and void transactions (but not reverse invoices)
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON and View and Manage AP/AR Data ON.
  2. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and delete a customer payment.
  2. Void a transaction.
  3. Try to reverse a work order invoice and a part sales invoice.
custom_expected:
The per-payment delete option is available and deleting a payment and voiding a transaction work.

Reversing a work order invoice is controlled by Work orders Delete, and reversing a part sales invoice by Part sales Delete — not by Invoicing & payments Delete.
